instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.zh: 非沙特籍人员工作许可

summary.en: A non-Saudi may work only after obtaining a Ministry work permit. Conditions include legal entry and residence, needed qualifications or a needed worker category, and a contract with an employer who is responsible for the worker.
summary.zh: 非沙特籍人员须取得人力资源部工作许可后方可工作。条件包括合法入境和居留、具备所需资格或属于所需工种，并与对其负责的雇主签有合同。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)
currency_note: English text published by MHRSD; the Arabic text governs. Reflects the Law as amended at the page's last update; the Implementing Regulations, ministerial decisions (for example midday-work bans) and GOSI occupational-hazard rules are not summarised.

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Work permit does not replace other licences
heading.zh: 工作许可不替代其他执照

summary.en: The work permit does not replace any permit or licence another authority requires for the work or profession.
summary.zh: 工作许可不能替代其他主管机关对从事该工作或职业所要求的许可或执照。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.zh: 非沙特籍员工须签书面定期合同

summary.en: A non-Saudi's employment contract must be written and fixed-term; if no term is stated, it runs for one year from the start of work and renews for the same period if work continues.
summary.zh: 非沙特籍员工的劳动合同须为书面定期合同；未约定期限的，自实际开始工作之日起为期一年，期满后继续工作的视为按同样期限续签。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Work only in the permitted profession
heading.zh: 只能从事许可所列职业

summary.en: The employer may not employ the worker in a profession other than the one stated in the work permit, and the worker may not change profession before completing the legal procedure.
summary.zh: 雇主不得安排工人从事工作许可所列职业以外的工作；工人在完成法定变更手续前不得改换职业。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: No working for others without procedure
heading.zh: 未经程序不得为他人工作

summary.en: An employer may not let its worker work for another employer or on the worker's own account, and the worker may not do so, except under the prescribed rules; employing another employer's worker is prohibited.
summary.zh: 除按规定程序外，雇主不得让其工人为其他雇主或为自己工作，工人也不得如此；雇主不得雇用其他雇主的工人。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Recruitment and permit costs on the employer
heading.zh: 招聘与许可费用由雇主承担

summary.en: The employer bears recruitment costs, residence and work permit fees and renewals and late-renewal fines, change-of-profession fees, exit/re-entry fees, and the worker's return ticket at the end of the relationship.
summary.zh: 雇主承担招聘费用、居留证和工作许可费用及续期费用和逾期罚款、职业变更费、出入境签证费，以及劳动关系结束后工人回国的机票。

instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Wages are paid in Saudi currency: daily-rated workers at least weekly, monthly-paid workers monthly, and piece-rate work longer than two weeks with weekly payments for work done.
summary.zh: 工资以沙特货币支付：日薪工人至少每周支付一次，月薪工人每月支付一次；计件工作超过两周的，每周按完成量支付。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: A worker may not work more than 8 actual hours a day (daily standard) or 48 hours a week (weekly standard); in Ramadan, hours for Muslims are capped at 6 a day or 36 a week.
summary.zh: 按日标准每天实际工作不超过8小时，按周标准每周不超过48小时；斋月期间穆斯林员工每天不超过6小时、每周不超过36小时。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)
currency_note: English text published by MHRSD; the Arabic text governs. Reflects the Law as amended at the page's last update; the Implementing Regulations, ministerial decisions (for example midday-work bans) and GOSI occupational-hazard rules are not summarised.

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: With Ministry approval, establishments working in shifts may exceed 8 hours a day or 48 a week if the average over three weeks or less does not exceed those limits.
summary.zh: 经部里批准，实行轮班的单位可以超过每天8小时或每周48小时，但以三周或更短期间平均计算不得超过上述上限。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Friday is the paid weekly rest day of at least 24 consecutive hours; after notifying the Labour Office the employer may substitute another day for some workers. The rest day may not be replaced by cash.
summary.zh: 星期五为带薪每周休息日，不少于连续24小时；雇主通知劳动办公室后，可为部分工人改定其他日期。休息日不得以金钱替代。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)
currency_note: English text published by MHRSD; the Arabic text governs. Reflects the Law as amended at the page's last update; the Implementing Regulations, ministerial decisions (for example midday-work bans) and GOSI occupational-hazard rules are not summarised.

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Overtime is paid at the hourly wage plus 50% of the basic wage, or by paid compensatory leave with the worker's consent; all hours worked on holidays and official vacations are overtime.
summary.zh: 加班工资为小时工资加基本工资的50%；经工人同意也可以带薪补休代替。节假日和法定假日的全部工作时间均视为加班。

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.zh: 卫生工作场所与职业安全标准

summary.en: The employer must keep the establishment healthy and clean, provide adequate lighting and potable water for drinking and washing, and follow the OSH rules, procedures and standards set by Minister's decision.
summary.zh: 雇主须保持单位卫生清洁，提供充足照明以及饮用和洗涤用水，并遵守部长决定规定的职业安全与健康规则、程序和标准。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)
currency_note: English text published by MHRSD; the Arabic text governs. Reflects the Law as amended at the page's last update; the Implementing Regulations, ministerial decisions (for example midday-work bans) and GOSI occupational-hazard rules are not summarised.

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.zh: 防护措施与张贴安全须知

summary.en: Every employer must take the precautions needed to protect workers from work hazards and diseases and from machinery, post safety instructions conspicuously in Arabic and, where necessary, a language the workers understand, and may not charge or deduct wages for this protection.
summary.zh: 雇主须采取必要措施保护工人免受工作和机械带来的危害与疾病，在显著位置用阿拉伯语及必要时工人能理解的语言张贴安全须知，并不得为此向工人收费或扣减工资。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

heading.zh: 危害告知与个人防护装备

summary.en: Before work starts, the employer must tell the worker the hazards of the job, require the prescribed protective equipment, provide suitable PPE and train the worker in its use.
summary.zh: 开工前雇主须告知工人岗位危害，要求其使用规定的防护装备，并提供合适的个人防护装备、培训其正确使用。

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Worker's duty to use protective equipment
heading.zh: 工人使用防护装备的义务

summary.en: The worker must use and maintain the protective equipment for each operation, follow health and safety instructions, and not misuse, damage or disable the protective means provided.
summary.zh: 工人须针对每项作业使用并维护规定的防护装备，遵守健康安全指令，不得滥用、损坏或破坏所提供的防护设施。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: The employer must take precautions against fire, provide technical means to control it, keep escape routes usable at all times and post fire-prevention instructions conspicuously.
summary.zh: 雇主须采取防火措施，配备控制火灾的技术手段，确保疏散通道随时可用，并在显著位置张贴防火须知。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Liability for visitors and others on site
heading.zh: 对进入现场的其他人员的责任

summary.en: The employer is responsible for accidents to non-employees who lawfully enter the workplace if caused by negligence in the technical precautions the work requires, and must compensate them.
summary.zh: 因雇主疏于采取工作性质所要求的技术防护措施，导致经许可进入工作场所的非本单位人员受伤或受损的，雇主负责并须赔偿。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)
currency_note: English text published by MHRSD; the Arabic text governs. Reflects the Law as amended at the page's last update; the Implementing Regulations, ministerial decisions (for example midday-work bans) and GOSI occupational-hazard rules are not summarised.

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: For a work injury or occupational disease, the employer must provide treatment and bear all related expenses, including hospital, tests, X-rays, prosthetics and transport; this chapter does not apply where GOSI occupational-hazard insurance covers the establishment (Art. 132).
summary.zh: 工人发生工伤或患职业病的，雇主须提供治疗并承担全部相关费用，包括住院、检查化验、X光、假肢和就医交通。单位已参加社会保险（GOSI）职业危害险的，本章不适用（第132条）。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: For temporary disability the worker receives full wage for 60 days, then 75% during treatment; a year of treatment or no prospect of recovery counts as total disability. Permanent total disability or death is compensated at three years' earnings, at least SAR 54,000; partial disability pro rata.
summary.zh: 暂时丧失劳动能力的，前60天发全额工资，此后治疗期间发75%；治疗满一年或经医学认定无法康复的视为完全伤残。永久完全伤残或死亡的补偿为三年收入，最低5.4万里亚尔；部分伤残按比例补偿。

instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Every employer must provide one or more first-aid kits; the regulations set their contents and number and the qualifications of first-aiders.
summary.zh: 每个雇主须配备一个或多个急救箱；其内容、数量及急救人员资格由条例规定。

instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Workers exposed to listed occupational diseases must be examined by a physician at least once a year, with results recorded in the employer's records and the workers' files.
summary.zh: 可能接触法定职业病危害的工人，雇主须安排医生至少每年体检一次，结果记入雇主档案和工人个人档案。

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

heading.en: Housing, camps and meals in remote areas
heading.zh: 偏远地区的住宿、营地与膳食

summary.en: Employers working in areas remote from population centres, mines, quarries and oil exploration sites must provide housing, camps and meals; their specifications are set by Minister's decision.
summary.zh: 在远离居民区的地区、矿山、采石场和石油勘探点作业的雇主，须为工人提供住房、营地和膳食；具体标准由部长决定规定。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)
version: MHRSD English web text (page updated 7 Sep 2025)

instrument: Labor Law (Royal Decree No. M/51 of 1426H, as amended)
instrument_zh: 沙特劳动法（伊历1426年第M/51号王室法令，经修订）

summary.en: Where workplaces are not served by regular transport at times matching working hours, the employer must transport workers daily from their residence or an assembly point and back.
summary.zh: 工作地点无与工作时间相匹配的常规交通时，雇主须每天负责工人在住所或集合点与工作地点之间的往返交通。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD)

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: If unforeseeable extraordinary events make performance excessively onerous and threaten heavy loss, the debtor may promptly ask the other party to negotiate without suspending performance; failing agreement in a reasonable time, the court may reduce the onerous obligation to a reasonable level. Contrary agreements are void.
summary.zh: 因订约时无法预见的特殊事件致使履行过于艰难、可能造成重大损失的，债务人可及时请求对方协商，但不因此停止履行；合理期限内未达成一致的，法院可将过重的义务减至合理程度。相反约定无效。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: If performance of an obligation in a bilateral contract becomes impossible for a reason beyond the debtor's control, it and the counter-obligation are extinguished and the contract ends automatically; partial or temporary impossibility affects only that part, and the creditor may seek termination.
summary.zh: 双务合同中一方义务因不可归责于债务人的原因而不能履行的，该义务及对待义务消灭，合同自动解除；部分或暂时不能履行的，仅就该部分消灭，债权人可请求解除合同。

heading.en: Performance at the defaulting party's expense
heading.zh: 由违约方承担费用的替代履行

summary.en: If the debtor fails to perform an act, the creditor may ask the court for permission to have it performed at the debtor's expense, and in urgent cases may do so without permission.
summary.zh: 债务人不履行作为义务的，债权人可请求法院许可由他人代为履行，费用由债务人承担；紧急情况下可不经法院许可自行代为履行。

The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.zh: 约定赔偿金（误期违约金）

summary.en: Parties may fix compensation in advance. It is not payable if the creditor suffered no harm; the court may reduce it if excessive or if the obligation was partly performed, or increase it for fraud or gross negligence. Contrary agreements are void.
summary.zh: 双方可预先约定赔偿金额。债权人未受损害的不得请求；约定金额过高或主债务已部分履行的，法院可酌减；因债务人欺诈或重大过失致损害超过约定额的，可酌增。相反约定无效。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Definition of the contract for service

summary.en: A contract for service is one by which a contractor makes a thing or carries out work for a fee without being the client's subordinate or agent.
summary.zh: 承揽合同是承包方为取得报酬而制作某物或完成某项工作、且不隶属于委托方也不作为其代理人的合同。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: Contractor-supplied materials must meet the agreed specifications or, failing these, be fit for purpose by custom. For client-supplied materials the contractor must take reasonable care, observe technical standards and return the unused materials.
summary.zh: 承包方提供的材料须符合约定规格，未约定的按惯例须适合预定用途。对委托方提供的材料，承包方须尽合理注意义务、遵守技术标准，并退还未用材料。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Completion on time and to standard

summary.en: The contractor must complete the work per the contract and within the agreed period or, absent these, to prevailing standards within a reasonable time.
summary.zh: 承包方须按合同在约定期限内完工；未约定的，按通行标准在合理期限内完工。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Notice to correct, replacement contractor and termination
heading.zh: 限期整改、更换承包方与解除合同

summary.en: If the contractor breaches the contract during the work, the client may set a reasonable period to correct; if not corrected, it may have another contractor complete or correct the work at the original contractor's expense or seek termination. Immediate termination may be sought if the defect cannot be cured or delay makes timely completion impossible.
summary.zh: 施工中承包方违约的，委托方可给予合理期限要求整改；逾期未改的，可由其他承包方完成或整改，费用由原承包方承担，或请求解除合同。缺陷无法补救或延误已使按期完工不可能的，可请求立即解除合同。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: If the thing is destroyed before delivery for a reason not attributable to the contractor, the contractor cannot claim the fee or expenses unless the client was in default of taking delivery.
summary.zh: 工作物在交付前因不可归责于承包方的原因灭失的，承包方不得请求报酬或费用，但委托方迟延接收的除外。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Payment on delivery and for phases
heading.zh: 交付付款与分阶段付款

summary.en: Unless agreed otherwise, the fee is due on delivery; where the work has phases or unit prices, completed distinguishable parts are paid after inspection and acceptance.
summary.zh: 除另有约定外，报酬在交付时支付；工作分阶段或按单价计酬的，对可区分的已完成部分经检验验收后支付。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: Under a unit-rate contract, if the estimated quantities must be significantly exceeded, the contractor must notify the client at once of the expected fee increase or lose recovery of the excess; for a considerable excess the client may withdraw, paying for completed work.
summary.zh: 单价合同中如必须大幅超出估算工程量，承包方须立即通知委托方预计增加的报酬，否则丧失超出部分费用的追偿权；超出很大的，委托方可退出合同，但须支付已完工程价款。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Lump sum, design changes and exceptional circumstances
heading.zh: 总价、设计变更与特殊情势

summary.en: Under a lump sum for an agreed design, the contractor cannot claim more for rising material or labour costs, nor for design changes unless due to the client's fault or authorised with an agreed increase. If general unforeseeable circumstances upset the balance, the court may restore it, including extending time or adjusting the fee, or terminate.
summary.zh: 按约定设计的总价合同，承包方不得因材料或人工成本上涨而要求加价；设计变更也不得加价，除非源于委托方过错或经其许可并同意加价。一般性不可预见情势导致合同失衡的，法院可恢复平衡（包括延长工期、调整报酬）或解除合同。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

summary.en: The contractor may subcontract all or part of the work unless law, the agreement or the nature of the work prevents it, and remains liable to the client. The subcontractor cannot claim from the client sums due to the contractor unless referred by the contractor.
summary.zh: 除法律、约定或工作性质禁止外，承包方可将全部或部分工作分包，并仍对委托方负责。分包方不得向委托方主张承包方应得的款项，但经承包方转付的除外。

authority: Ministry of Justice, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/191 of 18 June 2023
currency_note: Bureau of Experts translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. Government contracts are also governed by the Government Tenders and Procurement Law (replaced by a new law in 2026), which is not summarised. The contract-for-service chapter (Arts. 461-478) does not itself set a ten-year structural liability period.

instrument: Civil Transactions Law (Royal Decree No. M/191 of 2023)
instrument_zh: 沙特民事交易法（2023年第M/191号王室法令）

heading.en: Termination for an exigent matter; partial completion
heading.zh: 因紧急事由解除；部分完工

summary.en: Either party may seek termination for an exigent matter affecting its performance, compensating the other's harm. If the contractor cannot finish for reasons not attributable to it, it is paid for completed work and expenses in proportion to the client's benefit.
summary.zh: 任一方因影响其履约的紧急事由可请求解除合同，但须赔偿对方损失。承包方因不可归责于自己的原因未能完工的，按委托方所获利益比例支付已完工程价款及已支出费用。

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

heading.en: Key definitions incl. environmental impact assessment
heading.zh: 主要定义（含环境影响评价）

summary.en: Defines the competent authority (the Ministry or a national environmental centre), permits issued before an activity with environmental impact, licences, and the environmental impact assessment as a study to identify and evaluate a project's likely effects.
summary.zh: 定义主管机关（环境部或国家环境中心）、对有环境影响的活动事先签发的许可（permit）、执照（licence），以及用于识别和评估项目可能影响的环境影响评价。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Carrying out an environmental activity or one with environmental impact without a permit or licence is prohibited; holders must comply with the Law, regulations, permit conditions and authority instructions.
summary.zh: 未取得许可或执照，不得从事环境活动或对环境有影响的活动；持证者须遵守本法、条例、许可条件及主管机关的指示。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Any activity that may pollute, harm or impair the use of environmental media and water resources is prohibited, as the regulations specify.
summary.zh: 按条例规定，禁止任何可能污染、损害或妨碍环境介质和水资源使用的活动。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Licence or permit holders whose activities release emissions or pollutants must meet the environmental standards, act when approaching limits, install monitoring and measurement, and report emissions data to the competent authority periodically.
summary.zh: 活动会产生排放或污染物的持证者，须遵守环境标准，在接近限值时采取措施，设置监测和计量设施，并定期向主管机关报送排放数据。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Wastewater or treated liquids may not be discharged or injected into underground wells or any environmental medium without a permit.
summary.zh: 未经许可，不得向地下井或任何环境介质排放或注入废水或处理后的液体。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

heading.en: Permit to extract sand, gravel and rock

summary.en: A permit is required before removing or exploiting sand, gravel, rocks or mud.
summary.zh: 开采或取用砂、砾石、岩石或泥土前须取得许可。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

heading.en: Works in the marine and coastal environment
heading.zh: 海洋与海岸环境内的工程

summary.en: Excavating, landfilling, dredging, constructing or other activities that harm the marine and coastal environment require a permit or licence.
summary.zh: 在海洋和海岸环境中开挖、填海、疏浚、建造或从事其他可能造成损害的活动，须取得许可或执照。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Serious violations include discharging untreated wastewater into wells, environmental media or aquifer outcrops, discharges from ships, disposing of hazardous waste in environmental media, and killing or trading endangered wildlife.
summary.zh: 严重违法行为包括：向井、环境介质或含水层露头排放未经处理的废水，船舶排放污染物，向环境介质处置危险废物，以及猎杀或交易濒危野生动物。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Violations may incur a fine of up to SAR 20 million, suspension of the licence or permit for up to six months, or its revocation; the Minister classifies violations and penalties.
summary.zh: 违法行为可处最高2000万里亚尔罚款、暂停许可或执照最长六个月，或吊销许可或执照；违法行为及相应处罚的分级由部长决定。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.

instrument: Environmental Law (Royal Decree No. M/165 of 2020)
instrument_zh: 沙特环境法（2020年第M/165号王室法令）

summary.en: Committing the serious acts listed in Article 35 is punishable by up to 10 years' imprisonment and a fine of up to SAR 30 million, or either.
summary.zh: 实施第35条所列严重违法行为的，可处最高10年监禁和最高3000万里亚尔罚款，或二者择一。

authority: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) and the national environmental centres
version: Official translation; Royal Decree M/165 of 10 July 2020
currency_note: Official translation for guidance; the Arabic text governs. EIA procedure, permit categories and the violation classification are set by the Implementing Regulations, which are not summarised here.
